name: RepoWiki
description: Generate a browsable wiki for any repository — dependency graph, per-module analysis, Mermaid diagrams, and cited search.
author: cognia-next

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id for the analysis passes. Empty lets the host choose.

language.title: Output language
language.description: Language the wiki is written in.

concurrency.title: Concurrent module analyses
concurrency.description: How many modules are analysed at once. The host's own outbound gate still applies.

max_files.title: File cap
max_files.description: Stop scanning after this many files.

max_context_tokens.title: Context budget
max_context_tokens.description: Token budget for the project context sent with each pass. 0 means unlimited.

rag_top_k.title: Search results
rag_top_k.description: How many excerpts a search returns by default.

rag_index_wiki.title: Search the generated pages too
rag_index_wiki.description: Index the wiki's own prose alongside the code, so a question about the architecture page hits the page.

browser.reason: Python plugins run in the desktop subprocess host.

mobile.reason: Python plugins run in the desktop subprocess host — unavailable on mobile.
